files_changed.summary: Added PHASE G — Integration with 025-task-wire-document-view (Gate 1: an ask no task covered).
The task's plan doc (§2 goals/gate, §3 decisions, §7 contract scaffolding).
WorkspaceShell/Body accept injected children and render them in the main area, falling back to the placeholder (g1).
App-level composition of DocumentViewer + HighlightedPage through renderPage, with the region-tool state (g2/g3); no store hook (I4).
The route passes the composed WorkspaceDocument into WorkspaceShell as children.
2 composition tests (mocked viewer/page): page args flow, tool arms/disarms (g4).

decisions: New task: the route-wiring gap was not covered by 000-024, so per README Gate 1 it was added to 06 as 025 (PHASE G — Integration) and given a plan doc first (analyze.json NEW-1).

The composition lives at the app route because a feature may import only entities/sync from another feature (I3); the app component uses no store selector or dispatch (I4) and holds only the armed-tool useState.
WorkspaceShell gains an injected-children slot instead of importing document/highlight itself — the shell stays in its layer.
The viewer already resolves the session's main PDF and the viewport, so no new query or slice was added; DocumentViewer's renderPage supplies every page arg.
renderPage guards the nullable artifactId/profileId (the shell can render before the artifact loads) by returning null for that page.
The region-tool control is three buttons (Select / Rectangle / Freehand) mapped to MarqueeTool | null; it is authoring UI and its mobile placement waits for 022 (D-11).
